tasks.subject: Task 1: Orchestrator with single-file fixpoint
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Implement GDScriptFixpointInference::run() end to end (snapshot → collect → apply → verify → commit-with-cache-invalidation → report), proven on a single file whose two functions both get typed.

**Files:**
- Create: modules/gdscript/editor/gdscript_fixpoint_inference.h
- Create: modules/gdscript/editor/gdscript_fixpoint_inference.cpp
- Create: modules/gdscript/tests/test_fixpoint_inference.h

```json:metadata
{"files": ["modules/gdscript/editor/gdscript_fixpoint_inference.h", "modules/gdscript/editor/gdscript_fixpoint_inference.cpp", "modules/gdscript/tests/test_fixpoint_inference.h"], "verifyCommand": "./bin/godot.macos.editor.dev.arm64 --headless --test --test-suite=\"*Fixpoint*\" --force-colors", "acceptanceCriteria": ["run() public API exists", "single file fully typed and reported", "second run idempotent", "builds with tests=yes"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Cross-file convergence (acceptance criterion)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove the fixpoint types an A→B→C chain across three separate files, whereas a single pass types only the leaf.

**Files:**
- Modify: modules/gdscript/tests/test_fixpoint_inference.h (add a TEST_CASE)

```json:metadata
{"files": ["modules/gdscript/tests/test_fixpoint_inference.h"], "verifyCommand": "./bin/godot.macos.editor.dev.arm64 --headless --test --test-suite=\"*Fixpoint*\" --force-colors", "acceptanceCriteria": ["single pass types only leaf", "full run types whole chain, iterations>1"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Termination on cycles and honest reporting
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Guarantee the loop terminates on a dependency cycle without crashing, and assert report counts are honest.

**Files:**
- Modify: modules/gdscript/tests/test_fixpoint_inference.h (add a TEST_CASE)

```json:metadata
{"files": ["modules/gdscript/tests/test_fixpoint_inference.h"], "verifyCommand": "./bin/godot.macos.editor.dev.arm64 --headless --test --test-suite=\"*Fixpoint*\" --force-colors", "acceptanceCriteria": ["cycle terminates under ceiling, no crash", "report counts internally consistent"]}
```
